Use only the tools exposed for this stage. Use read_documents to batch several needed pages in one call, avoiding repeated model round-trips. Use the supplied stage-scoped catalog; do not read arbitrary paths or earlier runs. The originating study and its explanations remain hidden. For case units, definitions or processing facts, use request_case_definition; an isolated service releases only reviewed neutral facts with opaque evidence IDs. General literature retrieval remains restricted to independently dated earlier sources. You may reason conditionally while a case fact remains unknown. Use search_sources for actual missing public knowledge; returned access depth is explicit, not proof of relevance. analyze_csv reads every selected row, not the 12-row preview. Submit once using submit_result; if validation fails, the draft is saved locally. Use patch_result with the latest draft_ref and only changed fields; do not regenerate unchanged text. Original submissions remain archived. Every result requires summary (nonempty string) and artifacts, evidence, claims, limitations, next_actions (arrays, empty allowed), plus stage-specific fields. For development_step focus/uptake source, use a supplied source ID, document ID or unambiguous registered filename. Use a source-field locator instead of copying an exact quote when convenient. A registered document ID/path suffices if no specific field is selected; optional paraphrases are stored separately from exact quotes. For a JSON source, quote the exact string VALUE, without adding its field name. Alternatively supply quote_pointer (JSON pointer to a string) and omit quote; the exact selected string will be resolved and logged. For learning_request, context_ref="development_step" may replace duplicate gap/why_now strings; this references your own gap/reason, never changes its content. For sources[].local_path use the returned D-document ID to avoid copying long paths; it resolves to the exact registered file. source_use covers exactly broker_reply_source_ids, not the whole source catalog or new searches in this turn. Cite newly read tool sources in evidence/memory_notes with actual paths/URLs. Keep result text concise; use 0-1 useful memory notes unless multiple are necessary. Preserve branches and open issues. files is an object of relative artifact paths to complete text content; every declared artifact must exist or be provided in files. If artifacts is empty, your exact summary is saved automatically as an artifact; do not repeat the entire JSON as prose. For review-index-v2, start with the stage directory and read relevant result/before-input sections by document ID. Summaries are incomplete navigation excerpts, not evidence. Start with input_refs and inline bodies, not the entire provenance catalog. When reading a needed document, request the relevant JSON pointer or a useful page (up to 12000 characters); avoid repeated tiny probes. For review, source_stage must match the stage containing the exact quote; note_keys are actual memory_notes keys (often empty), not JSON field names. If an input body is omitted or represented by $document, read it by ID. No scientific text was summarized; originals and before-inputs remain readable. Online retrieval is enabled.

Execute agent_learn.md's learning and co-questioning plan. Chinese readable artifacts.
Do not read earlier project runs/candidates. Only use listed inputs, their cited source files,
the current case's exchanges, supplied memory, and public sources. A previous task is accessible
only through the supplied memory packet and its provenance. Do not scan old run directories.
Read the actual common sources behind summaries. Treat published findings as published knowledge.
Do not present them as discoveries. Preserve disagreements and all idea branches.
Use public sources via urllib/curl (Crossref, Europe PMC, PMC, arXiv, publishers as accessible).
Save retrieved text and exact URLs; distinguish full text, abstract and failed access.
No solving, scientific validation experiment, proof or novelty gate is required for ideas.
Small worked calculations are allowed to learn a concept, clearly labelled learning examples.
Save result.json with the six runtime fields plus the requested fields. Use summary as a STRING.
Do not spend your entire budget retrieving; save useful partial understanding if needed.
Study your actual controller reply. Identify directly relevant sources, transferable methods and irrelevant results; explain what changes in your assumption and what remains open. Classify every returned source; not_read is valid for sources not studied. Return source_use:[{source_id,relation:direct/method/irrelevant/not_read,reason}], learning_change, and an optional next learning_request. Label hypothetical worked examples. 
Also return memory_notes: 0-3 reusable notes; [] when unchanged. Each object has:
key (stable lower_case ASCII concept key; reuse an existing key when correcting it), title,
kind (source_knowledge/interpretation/hypothesis/correction),
mastery (read/explained/used; identify how the knowledge informed actual research when used),
understanding, conditions, open_questions (nonempty strings), optional example (text or null),
tags (array, include English and Chinese terms), sources (array of actual URLs or source paths),
revision_reason (required when the key already exists).
Separate published knowledge, your inference and untested hypotheses. 'Unknown' is a valid
open_questions string, never invent competence. Describe corrections explicitly.
Also return memory_use: array of {key,source_task,used_for,scope_check} for notes actually used;
return [] if none. State what you still cannot explain/use.


HYPOTHESIS DEVELOPMENT v3:
Use your disciplinary understanding and screened long-term memory to develop assumptions.
Start from a specific phenomenon, tension, difficulty or missing relation. When you have a
possible explanation or organizing principle, state what you suppose; merely changing a
'whether' question into an affirmative sentence adds no insight. An assumption can be an
explanation, conjectured relation, representation, distinction or method/construction principle.
Explore what conceptual move it makes and, CONDITIONALLY on the assumption, what changes in
our understanding or possible actions. Develop concrete consequences, not promises of impact.
Use these as thinking moves, not a checklist that every early idea must already satisfy.
Before requesting learning, identify a specific missing conceptual connection in the current
assumption, why it matters, and what understanding might change. Return to that same gap after
reading: explain a revised premise, relation or conditional consequence, or retain the gap.
Do not substitute more citations, caveats, controls or formal wording for conceptual development.
Measurement/method contributions remain valid when their concrete intellectual consequences are
articulated. No compulsory mechanism, scientific breakthrough, or progress at each turn.

In peer discussion, engage a specific assumption: elaborate a consequence, expose a hidden
premise, connect a disciplinary concept, propose a distinct explanation, or revise a relation.
Explain the reasoning. You may retain, revise, branch, or park your own line. No forced consensus,
disagreement, novelty claim, completed hypothesis or compulsory new branch each turn.
Evidence strength, proof, available data/tools, implementation and experimental feasibility
are NOT requirements for proposing, retaining or prioritizing a hypothesis. Do not turn
discussion into a feasibility review. Research/analysis requests remain optional resources
for thinking. Correct concrete errors in premises while keeping conditional hypotheses distinct
from established observations; lack of evidence alone is not a refutation.

hypothesis_state.self contains your saved branches; peer_branches belong to their named owners.
Return hypothesis_updates: [] when nothing changed, otherwise full cards:
{key: stable local identifier [A-Za-z0-9_]+, base_version: 0 for new or supplied own version,
assumption: nonempty provisional claim, motivation: specific phenomenon/difficulty/relation,
conceptual_move: string or null if still unclear,
implications: [specific conditional consequences, may be empty],
open_questions: [unresolved conceptual questions, may be empty],
status: developing/parked, reason: why propose/change/park/resume,
influenced_by: [exact ref objects from supplied hypothesis_state],
depends_on: [exact supplied hypothesis refs used as premises; [] if none]}.
Influence is not logical dependence. Declare depends_on only for actual premises; do not invent
links. revision_obligations lists your branches whose declared premises changed or themselves
await review. This does NOT mean the branch is false. For each obligation return
 dependency_responses:[{ref:exact hypothesis_ref,action:revise/reaffirm/park/unresolved,reason}].
Reaffirm/revise requires an updated full card citing current dependency versions; changing only
links is recorded as provenance maintenance, not conceptual progress. Park/unresolved retains
the branch and its warning. Reasoned reaffirmation is valid; do not mechanically follow criticism.
Dependencies not explicitly declared cannot be inferred by this structural checker.
Omitting a branch retains it. To keep an alternative, use a new key and cite the parent ref;
never overwrite a peer's branch. Missing conceptual_move or implications is allowed for an
early assumption. Keep hypothetical consequences explicitly hypothetical, including examples.
Reusable conceptual learning can also be saved through existing memory_notes, kind:hypothesis,
with actual source provenance and same-key revisions. Run-local branches do not replace your
long-term disciplinary memory or its source screening. Do not invent empirical support.


Optional learning_request: {needed:boolean, gap, why_now, queries:[strings],
urls:[], source_ids:[], record_ids:[], operations:[], case_questions:[]}.
Use case_questions for actual case definitions/units/processing order; literature cannot
reconstruct undocumented case facts. These questions dispatch even when needed:false.
General theory and explanation-development requests use queries/gap. For case facts, the
isolated material service releases supported neutral definitions, not hidden conclusions.
The controller searches and returns actual readable content. Keep your own scientific query;
classify returned sources as directly relevant, transferable method, or irrelevant, with reasons.
Do not treat a successful download as understanding. No compulsory tool use.
For a small worked calculation use an operation {kind:"calculation", question,
bindings:{name: numeric scalar/array}, expression: numeric array expression,
expected: optional numeric value/array}. Available arithmetic, slices and named functions
include mean,sum,std,norm,diff,abs,sqrt. Define which rows/columns mean which entities.
Top-level analysis_plan also dispatches. needed:false disables literature search, not explicit
calculations. Unsupported requests return a pending capability task; no scientific rejection.
Keep purely tentative proposals in hypothesis_updates/next_actions, not execution fields.


HYPOTHESIS CONTENT CYCLE:
Use development_cycle as a thinking context, not a demand to invent progress. Choose one
specific explanatory relation, construction, distinction or unresolved phenomenon from its
sources. Locate the conceptual gap: what connection/premise/consequence is still unclear?
Choose a next move because of this gap: learn, derive, connect, reframe, or hold. Explain why
that move could change understanding. For learning, use this gap in learning_request.gap and
why_now, and formulate targeted queries; do not request a broad survey merely to fill a stage.
In discussion, take up a peer's concrete relation and explain how your discipline extends,
challenges or changes its consequences. Generic agreement about controls or feasibility is
not a substitute; a measurement contribution is valid when its specific consequences matter.
Study returned services against the gap that requested them, including failures and pending
capabilities. Do not call retrieval success learning. If nothing changes, say so and preserve
the gap. Own previous_steps carry unfinished thinking across phases and sessions. When the
controller flags repeated_no_change, reconsider the missing connection, premise, or next
learning move; holding a branch is valid. The flag uses supplied peer content comparisons, not a quality verdict. A shared interpretation is normal.
Return development_step:{focus:{source:exact development_cycle.sources key,quote:exact excerpt},
gap:nonempty text, action:learn/derive/connect/reframe/hold, reason:nonempty text,
expected_change:text or null for hold,
uptake:[{source:exact source key,quote:exact excerpt or null only for unresolved,
effect:revise/extend/challenge/unchanged/unresolved,reason:how this affects the focus,
consequence:conditional consequence or null when none follows}],
outcome:{kind:relation/implication/clarification/unchanged/uncertain,
statement:what changed or did not, remaining_gap:text or null}}.
Account once for EACH service key in required_service_uptake. If peer_sources is nonempty,
engage at least one (unresolved with a reason is valid). Other uptake is optional. Quotes must
come from the named source; for published claims quote readable source content, not metadata.
For relation/implication outcomes, preserve the resulting claim in a hypothesis_update's
assumption or implications. This records an author's proposal, NOT confirmed novelty/progress.
No compulsory new relation, branch, agreement, data, experiment, proof or implementation.


QUESTION STATE PROTOCOL v2:
question_state.self is YOUR authoritative current personal question. peer_questions belong
to their named owners. shared_question is the discussion's current shared question, or null.
Do not reconstruct your prior question from the latest peer message. The controller records
the actual before-state; do NOT return question_before or question_after.
Return personal_question_update: {base: the exact self.ref object, action: retain/revise,
question: your current or revised personal question, reason: a nonempty explanation,
influenced_by: array of exact question ref objects from this supplied packet}.
Retain means the question text stays exactly the same. Revise may include adopting a peer's
line or the shared question: explain why; use influenced_by to identify relevant question refs.
You need not preserve disagreement or a distinct personal question if you decide to change it.
Separately return shared_question_update: null, or {base: the exact shared_question.ref (null
if none yet), action: propose/revise/retain, question: shared question text, reason: nonempty,
influenced_by: array of refs from this packet}. Propose is only for a first shared question.
A shared question is a versioned proposal, not proof of peer agreement. Revising it NEVER
changes another researcher's personal question. Your own personal update is independent too.

Use controller-owned question_state, never invent question_before/question_after.
Keep hypotheses tied to specific entities/relations in this situation. A measurement or representation contribution is legitimate; explain its concrete consequences without forcing a natural mechanism.

They are described as discrete sums of simple hysteresis operators but can easily be reformulated as integral equations of continuous distribution functions using either a Preisach weight distribution function or a play distribution function. The models are mostly seen as phenomenological or mathematical tools but can also be related to friction-like pinning of domain-wall motions, where Rayleigh's law of magnetic hysteresis can be seen as the simplest case on either the play model or the Preisach model. They are poor at modeling other domain behavior, such as nucleation-driven hysteresis. Yet another hysteresis model is the stop model, which can be seen as the inverted version of the play model. This type of model has advantages for expressions linked to energy and can be related to Steinmetz equation of hysteresis losses. The models share several mathematical properties, such as the congruency property and wiping-out property, and both models have a history of dependence that can be described by the series of past reversal points. More generally, it is shown that the many models can be expressed as Preisach models, showing that they can be treated as subcategories of the Preisach type models. But there's a deeper conceptual issue: the mediator is not just a linear spring; it's a hysteretic two-state element. Adiabatic elimination of a hysteretic element is not valid when its barrier is finite: the eliminated variable has two branches, not a unique local equilibrium. At κ→1 its two branches merge, but the elimination formula diverges as K_k→0. Actually as K_k→0, J_eff diverges; that signals breakdown of perturbation. This is a conceptual move: replace "eliminate node" by "integrate out a two-state variable" — the effective interaction between neighbors is not a fixed J_eff but a state-dependent coupling: when mediator is in state σ_k, it exerts a force on neighbors; after eliminating, the neighbor-neighbor interaction is a "witness" term that depends on the mediator's history. Also in spin models, integrating out a fast spin gives effective interaction J_eff = -J_ik J_kj / K_k, but if the mediator is slow, it's a random field on neighbors, not a coupling.

This might be the key conceptual gap: The Schur complement assumes the mediator relaxes to a unique equilibrium; but a hysteron has two metastable branches. Thus the elimination produces an effective coupling only in the "single-valued" phase κ>1; below κ→1, the mediator remains a state variable and induces a state-dependent field, not a fixed edge. The crossover between "effective edge" and "hidden state" is governed by the mediator's barrier relative to neighbor coupling. The previous derivation says J_eff = -J_ik J_kj / K. That depends on sign convention. If Hamiltonian is +J σ_i σ_j (J>0 antiferro), then effective J_eff = -J_ik J_kj/K. So the sign flip may be an artifact of convention. This is important: the claim "same-sign neighbors -> antiferro effective edge" may be convention-dependent. We need correct concrete error in premise. The branch says "J_eff=−J_ik·J_kj/K_k，符号为两原边符号之积再取负". That corresponds to energy +J σσ (AF convention). If b<0 means FM, mapping needs care. The branch itself flags: "J_eff 符号到 FM/AF 的映射依赖 b 的定义约定". We can correct by defining a convention explicitly. The physical result: integrating out a mediator with positive stiffness yields an effective coupling whose sign is the product of the two bare coupling signs, with a negative sign in the Schur complement of the stiffness matrix (because the mediator's response opposes). In a spring network, if two neighbors are both coupled to the mediator with same sign, the effective spring between them has opposite sign (a negative spring), which is mechanically unstable—not a stable antiferro coupling. Ah, that's key: a negative effective spring is not the same as an antiferromagnetic interaction; it's an instability. In a mechanical network, a negative stiffness edge cannot be realized passively; it means the assumed equilibrium is unstable, and the system will buckle or the mediator will snap. So "manufacturing frustration" via negative effective coupling may be physically a "negative stiffness" that destroys the bistable states rather than creates a frustrated hysteron. This is a serious conceptual correction. The Schur complement of a stable spring network is positive semidefinite if the full stiffness matrix is positive definite; a negative effective coupling between two nodes can arise while the reduced matrix remains positive definite (off-diagonal negative, diagonal increased). So it's not necessarily unstable; it's like a network with a negative off-diagonal but positive definite. In spin language, that's an antiferro coupling, which is stable if diagonal terms dominate. In mechanical spring networks, negative off-diagonal stiffness means the force between two nodes is repulsive for displacement—can be stabilized by grounding. So it's possible.

But the mapping to "frustration" requires a loop with odd number of negative edges, and for a mechanical network the "spin" variables are bistable states, not continuous displacements. The Schur complement is a linear response around a state; a negative effective coupling might just shift thresholds, not create a new stable state. To create a frustrated loop, you need the effective coupling to be strong enough to flip the sign of the interaction between two-state elements, but also not so strong that it destabilizes the states. This is a condition. The branch's implication says "若 |J_eff| 与邻元自刚度同量级时，融合沿网络传播（传染）". That captures cutoff.

Another conceptual gap: "frustration" in hysteron networks is defined by the sign of the interaction in the hysteron Hamiltonian, where each hysteron has two states and thresholds. The effective coupling from integrating out a mediator is not necessarily a hysteron-hysteron interaction of the same form; it may be a multi-linear term or a random field. So the "effective graph" is not simply a graph with renormalized edges. The correct object may be a hypergraph or a state-dependent adjacency. This is a representation issue. That could be our development step outcome: clarify that the elimination yields a state-dependent field, not a fixed edge, unless the mediator is in its single-valued phase. The healing/manufacturing criterion should be conditional on the mediator being in the single-valued phase; otherwise it is a "hidden hysteron" that carries history and can produce path-dependent frustration. This is a real conceptual development.

Therefore "healing/manufacturing" based on sign of J_eff is a local statement, valid only if the reduced energy remains bistable and the mediator's branch is unique. We can derive a minimal model to see. Consider three bistable elements in series/chain with a mediator k. Each element has state σ_i = ±1 and internal coordinate x_i. Coupling springs. The full energy has multiple local minima. Eliminating the fast mediator coordinate yields an effective energy for neighbors that depends on the mediator's branch. This is a concrete conceptual distinction: "eliminated single-valued node" vs "hidden hysteron". The controller's note mentions "witness/hidden hysteron" as a query, but no source. This may be the next move: reframe from "fusion as renormalization" to "two regimes of elimination: slaved mediator (effective edge) vs hidden mediator (effective hyperedge/field)". Let's formalize. Full energy for three elements i,k,j with continuous internal coordinates and bistable wells. For small displacements around a state, the Hessian is K. The Schur complement of k gives effective stiffness between i and j: K_eff,ij = K_ij - K_ik K_kj / K_kk. In a spring network, K_ij is usually zero (no direct spring), so K_eff,ij = -K_ik K_kj / K_kk. Eliminate x_k: K_eff = K_ii - K_ik K_ki / K_kk = k_ik - k_ik^2/(K_0+k_ik+k_kj) = k_ik (K_0+k_kj)/(K_0+k_ik+k_kj). The off-diagonal between i and j: K_eff,ij = 0 - K_ik K_kj / K_kk = -(-k_ik)(-k_kj)/(K_0+k_ik+k_kj) = - k_ik k_kj/(K_0+k_ik+k_kj). So the effective stiffness off-diagonal is negative. The energy cross term is K_eff,ij x_i x_j, negative for positive x_i x_j, so same-sign displacements lower energy. That is a ferro-like coupling. If we define spin coupling J by energy -J σ_i σ_j, then J_eff = -K_eff,ij = +k_ik k_kj/(K_0+k_ik+k_kj) >0. So same-sign spring edges (both positive stiffness) give a positive (ferro) J_eff. The branch's formula J_eff=-J_ik J_kj/K likely used J as the stiffness off-diagonal (which is negative). If J_ik = -k_ik, J_kj = -k_kj, then J_ik J_kj = +k_ik k_kj; -product/K = -k_ik k_kj/K, which is K_eff,ij, not J_eff. So they confused the stiffness off-diagonal with the spin coupling. Thus our correction is right.

Now, the "same-sign neighbors" in the branch: If b<0 is FM, then b sign is not J sign directly; b is the threshold shift. A FM coupling J>0 gives b<0. So two FM edges have b<0 (same sign). The product J_ik J_kj >0 -> J_eff>0 (FM). The induced edge is FM, not AF. So the triangle is balanced. The branch said "同号邻边 -> 反号有效边" — wrong. Good.

Now, the loop parity. For a loop containing k and edges J_ik, J_kj, and a path P from j to i not through k, the product of edge signs around the loop is sign(J_ik J_kj * product(P)). After eliminating k, the new edge between i and j has J_eff = J_ik J_kj/K (plus any direct edge J_ij). If no direct edge, the new loop product is sign(J_eff * product(P)) = sign(J_ik J_kj * product(P)), same as old. So parity preserved. If there is a direct edge J_ij, the new edge is J_ij + J_eff; the new loop product is sign((J_ij+J_eff) * product(P)). This can differ from old if J_ij and J_eff have opposite signs and J_ij dominates. If they have same sign, sign is preserved. If J_ij is absent, preserved. This is a clean conditional.

If the mediator is on a negative stiffness branch K<0, J_eff = J_ik J_kj/K has opposite sign to product; parity flips. But K<0 is unstable, so the mediator will not stay there; it will snap. The adiabatic elimination around an unstable branch is not valid for the global state. So this is not a physical "manufacturing" mechanism in a stable equilibrium. It could be a transient during a snap, but then the system is not quasi-static. This is an important limitation.

At K→0+, J_eff diverges. The linear response breaks down when |J_eff| ~ neighbor stiffness. The neighbor self-stiffness renormalization k_A,eff = k_A - J_ik^2/K also diverges negative, meaning the neighbor's effective stiffness becomes negative; the whole reduced system becomes unstable. This is the cutoff: before K reaches 0, the composite loses stability; the mediator and neighbors snap together. So the "P axis endpoint" is a collective instability, not a clean deletion. This supports the "contagion" idea but with a different mechanism: the divergence is a sign of instability, not a strong stable coupling.

messages.reasoning_content:
Next actions strings.

We should possibly include `changed_because` to explain. Not required.

Now, let's think if there is an alternative interpretation: Maybe the branch's J_eff sign is actually correct if J is defined as the coupling in the Hamiltonian +J σ_i σ_j (AF convention). In that convention, J>0 is AF, and b<0 could be FM? The branch says b<0 FM. If J>0 AF, then b<0 (FM) corresponds to J<0. Then J_ik J_kj >0 for two FM edges (both J<0), and -product/K <0, which in AF convention (J<0) is FM. So the effective edge is FM, not AF. The branch says "反号有效边" relative to the two edges? If both edges are FM (J<0), the effective J_eff<0 is also FM, same sign. So even in that convention, the extra minus doesn't produce an opposite magnetic character; it produces the same. Let's check: Define energy +J σσ (J>0 AF). Two FM edges have J<0. Product positive. J_eff = -product/K <0, which is FM. So same magnetic character. The branch's "反号" is in the J value sign, but both J<0 and J_eff<0 are same sign. They said "同号邻边" meaning both J<0, then "反号有效边" meaning J_eff>0? But formula gives J_eff<0. So they misread. The formula preserves the sign of the product? If J_eff = -J_ikJ_kj/K, and J_ik,J_kj both negative, product positive, J_eff negative, same as both. If one positive one negative, product negative, J_eff positive, which is opposite to the negative edge and same as the positive edge. In general, J_eff = -product. If we compare J_eff to J_ik: J_eff/J_ik = -J_kj/K. If J_kj>0, opposite; if J_kj<0, same. So "same-sign neighbors" (both J<0) gives J_eff<0, same. "Opposite-sign neighbors" gives J_eff>0, same as the positive one. So the effective edge always has the sign of the product, not the negative? Wait, algebra: J_eff = -J_ik J_kj/K. If both J<0, product positive, J_eff negative. The product of the two edge signs is positive; J_eff is negative. So J_eff has the opposite sign of the product. But the "magnetic character" of an edge is the sign of J. The product of the two edge signs is positive (FM+FM = FM character product +?). The effective edge is negative (FM). So it has the same character as the two edges, not opposite. The product of the three edge signs in the triangle is J_ik*J_kj*J_eff = J_ik*J_kj*(-J_ikJ_kj/K) = -(J_ikJ_kj)^2/K <0. So the triangle is frustrated. Ah, I made a mistake: the product of the three edge signs is negative because J_eff has the opposite sign of the product. In the spring derivation with J as spin coupling (energy -Jσσ), J_eff = +product/K, so triangle product = +(product)^2/K >0. So the sign of J_eff relative to the product is the crux. In the AF convention (+Jσσ), J_eff = -product/K, so triangle product = -(product)^2/K <0, frustrated. But the physical magnetic character? Let's map. In AF convention, J>0 is AF. Two FM edges have J<0. Product positive. J_eff = -positive/K <0, which is FM. The triangle has two FM edges and one FM edge: all three FM. A triangle with all FM edges is not frustrated in the Ising sense? Wait, Ising frustration is defined by the product of the signs of the couplings: if the product is negative, frustrated. All three FM couplings (J<0) have product negative (since three negatives = negative). So a triangle with three FM edges is frustrated! Yes, because three "same" antiferro? No, in Ising, a triangle with all antiferromagnetic edges is frustrated; a triangle with all ferromagnetic edges is not. The sign convention matters: if J<0 is FM, then the product of three J<0 is negative, but the product of the "magnetic characters" (FM=+1) is positive. Frustration is defined by the product of the signs of the interactions as they appear in the energy. For energy -Jσσ (J>0 FM), frustration is product of J signs negative. For energy +Jσσ (J>0 AF), the same physical configuration has J signs reversed; frustration is product of J signs negative as well? Let's check: AF triangle with all J>0: energy +J(σσ+σσ+σσ). Is it frustrated? Yes, three AF edges on a triangle is frustrated. Product of J signs = positive, not negative. So the criterion is not simply product of J signs; it depends on the convention. The physical criterion is the product of the "exchange constants" in the convention where the energy is -Σ J σσ. If you use +J, then the exchange constant is -J. So frustration is product of (-J) signs negative -> product of J signs positive? For all AF J>0, product positive -> frustrated. Yes. So the sign of the product alone is not invariant; you must fix the energy convention. This is exactly why the branch's sign confusion matters.

Let's define the physical exchange coupling K_ij such that energy = -Σ K_ij σ_i σ_j. Then K>0 is FM, K<0 is AF. Frustration = product of K signs negative. In the spring derivation, K_eff = +k_ik k_kj/K >0 (FM) for two normal springs. The triangle has K_ik>0, K_kj>0, K_eff>0; product positive, not frustrated. Good. So our correction using K (energy -Kσσ) is consistent. The branch used J perhaps as the stiffness off-diagonal, which is -K for a normal spring. Then J_ik J_kj = K_ik K_kj (positive), and -product/K = -K_eff, i.e., the stiffness off-diagonal, not the exchange K. They then called the sign of this "edge sign" and got confusion. The correct exchange is K_eff = +J_ik J_kj/K if J is the exchange. So our correction stands.

We should state the convention explicitly: "令能量为 −Σ K_ij σ_i σ_j，K>0 为铁磁型；不要用刚度矩阵非对角元 J 代替 K." Then the formula is K_eff = +K_ik K_kj/K_k. The induced triangle product = (K_ik K_kj)^2/K_k >0. This is unambiguous. If someone uses the stiffness off-diagonal S_ij = -K_ij, then S_eff = -S_ik S_kj/K_k? Let's derive: S_ik=-K_ik, S_kj=-K_kj. S_eff = -S_ik S_kj/K = -(+K_ik K_kj)/K = -K_eff. So the stiffness off-diagonal is negative of the exchange. The branch's formula with J_eff=-J_ikJ_kj/K is correct for the stiffness off-diagonal S, not for the exchange K. That's the precise correction. We can write: "上一版的 J 实际是刚度矩阵非对角元 S（对普通弹簧 S<0），不是能量耦合 K；两者差一个负号。若把 J 当 K，公式应为 +；若把 J 当 S，公式 − 但符号含义相反，不能直接读成 FM/AF." This is a nuanced and correct explanation.

This is a strong contribution. We should include it in the artifact and memory note.

Now, the "healing/manufacturing" labels: In the exchange convention, two edges with the same magnetic character (both K>0 or both K<0) produce K_eff = K_ik K_kj/K >0 if both same sign? Wait, if both K<0 (AF), product positive, K_eff>0 (FM). So two AF edges produce an FM effective edge. The triangle has K_ik<0, K_kj<0, K_eff>0; product positive? (-)(-)(+) = +, not frustrated. A triangle with two AF and one FM is not frustrated (product positive). So same-character AF edges produce an FM effective edge, and the triangle is balanced. If one AF and one FM, product negative, K_eff<0 (AF); triangle has (-)(+)(-) = +, balanced. In fact, any two edges plus the induced edge product = K_ik K_kj K_eff = (K_ik K_kj)^2/K >0, so always balanced. This is the general result: a tree of two edges plus the induced edge is always balanced, regardless of the signs of the two edges. It cannot be frustrated. That's a very clean statement. The induced edge's character is the product of the two edge characters (FM*FM=FM, AF*AF=FM, FM*AF=AF). So the triangle is balanced. Yes.

Thus "manufacturing frustration" in a tree is impossible. The only way to get frustration is a pre-existing loop or a direct edge that is not simply the induced edge. If there is a direct edge K_ij, the new edge is K_ij + K_eff. The triangle product is (K_ij + K_eff) K_ik K_kj. The old loop? There's no old loop without the direct edge. If the direct edge exists, the triangle before elimination has product K_ij K_ik K_kj. After elimination, product (K_ij + K_eff) K_ik K_kj. The parity can change if K_ij and K_eff have opposite signs and K_ij+K_eff has opposite sign to K_ij. That requires |K_eff|>|K_ij| and opposite sign. So the criterion is "direct edge present and induced edge dominates oppositely". This is a precise conditional.

What about a loop of length >3? If the mediator k is on a loop and there is a path P between i and j, the old loop product is K_ik K_kj * P. After elimination, the new loop product is (K_ij + K_eff) * P, where K_ij is any direct edge between i and j. If no direct edge, K_ij=0, new product = K_eff * P = K_ik K_kj * P / K, same sign as old. So parity preserved. If direct edge, same condition. This generalizes.

So the result: "stable elimination preserves the frustration parity of every loop that passes through k, unless there is a direct edge between k's neighbors that competes with the induced edge." That's the core.

Now, what about the neighbor self-stiffness renormalization? K_A,eff = K_A - K_ik^2/K_k. If K_k>0, this reduces the neighbor's stiffness; if it becomes negative, the neighbor loses stability. This can happen before K_k→0 if K_ik^2 > K_A K_k. So the cutoff is when the Schur complement diagonal becomes negative. This is a concrete criterion for the breakdown of the effective graph: not just |K_eff| ~ K_A, but K_A,eff < 0. We can write: "The reduced stiffness matrix must remain positive definite; the elimination is valid only while K_A,eff>0 and the 2x2 Schur complement is positive definite. When it ceases, the composite loses stability and the mediator cannot be treated as slaved." This is a useful condition. It uses only the stiffness matrix, no new data. We can include in implications/open questions.

Let's derive the 2x2 Schur complement condition for i,j after eliminating k:
K_eff = [[K_i - K_ik^2/K_k, -K_ik K_kj/K_k],
         [-K_ik K_kj/K_k, K_j - K_kj^2/K_k]]
Positive definite requires diagonals >0 and determinant >0. The determinant condition is the stability of the composite. This is a concrete cutoff. We can state without full algebra: "the reduced 2×2 stiffness must remain positive definite; otherwise the assumed equilibrium is unstable and the effective edge is not a stable interaction." That's enough.

This also addresses the "contagion" idea: if the neighbor's effective stiffness is reduced, it may become unstable, so the fusion propagates. But the mechanism is instability, not a stable strong coupling. The P axis endpoint is a collective instability. Good.

Now, what about the peer's "degeneracy_heals_frustration" and "κ→1 deletes element"? Our result says in a tree, there is no frustration to heal; in a loop, stable elimination preserves parity. So the peer's claim is wrong in the loop case, and trivial in the tree case. We can state this explicitly. This is a strong challenge. The peer's branch status is developing; we don't overwrite. We can note in `changed_because` or `branches` that peer branch is challenged, not merged.

Now, the "source_use" empty might make `learning_change` seem like no learning. But we did learn from our own derivation and the service's structural note. The prompt says "Do not call retrieval success learning. If nothing changes, say so and preserve the gap." We can say the literature gap is unchanged, but the conceptual premise changed due to derivation. That's fine.

We need perhaps use `request_case_definition` for the direct edge question? The prompt says use it for actual case facts. We could ask now, but we already have a case question in learning_request. The case definition service may answer. Should we call it? It would give a neutral fact if supported. The question: "network_C 的装配图中，是否存在不经过转子3的1–4直接耦合边（弹簧或钢丝）？" This is a concrete case fact. It could resolve our conditional. Let's try. If it returns unknown, we can report. It might be worth one call.

## 1. 本轮实际返回
控制器回复（D7acf…）的 knowledge_attempts：6 次检索全部 retrieval_failed（Europe PMC / Crossref / OpenAlex，ValueError），sources 为空。case 问题「network_C 各耦合边的并联/交叉与安装距离」第三次 unknown；新问「是否存在不经过转子3的1–4直接边」也 unknown（F9d…）。因此没有可分类的返回源；source_use 为空不是「无相关性」，而是「没有可读源」。

## 2. 焦点
上一轮写：J_eff = −J_ik J_kj / K_k，并据此说同号邻边诱导反号有效边、造受挫三角。这里没有检查 J 是能量交换耦合，还是刚度矩阵非对角元。

## 3. 符号检查
固定能量约定 E = −Σ K_ij σ_i σ_j，K>0 为铁磁型。三节点 i–k–j，k 的约束刚度为 K_k。线性响应下消去 x_k：
x_k = (K_ik σ_i + K_kj σ_j)/K_k，
E_eff = −(K_ik σ_i + K_kj σ_j)^2/(2K_k)
= −(K_ik^2+K_kj^2)/(2K_k) − (K_ik K_kj/K_k) σ_i σ_j。
所以
K_eff = +K_ik K_kj / K_k，
K_i,eff = K_i − K_ik^2/K_k，K_j,eff = K_j − K_kj^2/K_k。
若把刚度矩阵非对角元记为 S_ij = −K_ij，则 S_eff = −K_eff = −S_ik S_kj/K_k。上一版的 −J_ikJ_kj/K 对应的是 S，不是 K；把 S 的符号直接读成 FM/AF 就多了一个负号。

## 4. 树与回路
在 i–k–j 链上，消去 k 后新增边 i–j。三角 i–k–j–i 的交换耦合乘积：
K_ik · K_kj · K_eff = (K_ik K_kj)^2/K_k > 0。
所以它总是平衡的，不能由「同号邻边」制造受挫三角。更一般地，若 k 在回路中，i 与 j 之间没有直接边，则
K_eff · P = (K_ik K_kj/K_k) · P
与原回路乘积 K_ik K_kj P 同号：稳定消去保持受挫奇偶，不单独 healing 或 manufacturing。

只有两种情形能翻转奇偶：
1. i 与 j 之间已有直接边 K_ij，新边为 K_ij + K_eff；两者反号且 |K_eff| > |K_ij| 时，新边符号翻转。
2. 中介在负刚度支 K_k < 0；此时 K_eff 翻号，但该支不是稳定平衡，绝热消去失效。应把中介保留为隐藏慢变量，而不是写成一条稳定有效边。

## 5. 与 peer 的分歧
peer `degeneracy_heals_frustration`：退化单元只是对邻居的确定性场，只移阈值、不储历史，故不单独产生多周期。
- 同意「不储历史」和「稳定支上不单独产生多周期」。
- 不同意「只移阈值」：消去它会在邻元间留下有效耦合，改变联合能量；即使无历史，也会改变回路符号乘积的幅度，并在有直接边时改变符号。
- 因此「κ 跨 1 抹平受挫奇偶」在树上平凡真（本来无挫折），在回路上不成立（无直接边时奇偶保持）；只有直接边竞争或负刚度支才可能改变。

peer `unilateral_stop_state`：κ→1 时单元退化为 γ 的单值单调函数，环路关闭。
- 同意单元局部环路关闭。
- 不同意把它读成网络回路被删除：单元局部单值化后仍可作为约束在中介两侧留下有效边；网络级周期/嵌套要单独读。

## 6. 条件性后果
- pair_A/pair_B：两转子无中介、无回路，R 轴同类、P 轴异类的旧判断不变。
- network_C：s3 的该翻未翻不能仅由 κ_3→1 读成制造挫折；必须先知道 1–3 与 3–j 的边符号，以及 1–j 是否有直接边。后者仍 unknown。
- 夹紧协议：仍读不到消去效应；要读它必须让中介自由。
- 复合元稳定性：当 2×2 Schur 补不再正定时，有效图描述失效；P 轴端点是集体失稳/截断，不是干净的单点删除。

## 7. 学习性算例（假设，未测）
取 K_ik=1, K_kj=−1, K_k=2（任意单位）。K_eff=(1·−1)/2=−0.5。三角乘积 = 1·(−1)·(−0.5)=+0.5，平衡。
若再加直接边 K_ij=+2，新边 = 2−0.5=1.5；三角乘积 = 1·(−1)·1.5=−1.5，受挫。
所以决定奇偶的是直接边与诱导边的竞争，不是「两条邻边是否同号」。

# 05_return_1 学习与共同提问：稳定消去的符号与回路奇偶

## 1. 本轮实际返回
- 控制器回复 D7acf...：6 次检索全部 `retrieval_failed`（Europe PMC/Crossref/OpenAlex，ValueError），`sources: []`。
- case 问题（network_C 各边并联/交叉与安装距离）第三次 `unknown`。
- 新问：network_C 是否存在不经过转子3的1–4直接边？`unknown`（F9d...）。
- 因此没有可分类的返回源；`source_use: []` 不是“无相关性”，而是“没有可读源”。

## 2. 焦点：上一轮的符号是否成立
上一轮写：J_eff = −J_ik J_kj / K_k，并据此说同号邻边诱导反号有效边、造受挫三角。

问题：这里的 J 是能量耦合，还是刚度矩阵非对角元？

固定约定：能量 E = −Σ K_ij σ_i σ_j，K>0 为铁磁型。对三节点 i–k–j，k 有约束刚度 K_k，线性响应下消去 x_k：
x_k = (K_ik σ_i + K_kj σ_j)/K_k
代回：
E_eff = −(K_ik σ_i + K_kj σ_j)^2/(2K_k)
= −(K_ik^2+K_kj^2)/(2K_k) − (K_ik K_kj/K_k) σ_i σ_j.
所以
K_eff = +K_ik K_kj / K_k.
邻元自刚度：K_i,eff = K_i − K_ik^2/K_k，K_j,eff = K_j − K_kj^2/K_k.

若把刚度矩阵非对角元记为 S_ij = −K_ij，则 S_eff = −K_eff = −S_ik S_kj / K_k。上一版的 −J_ikJ_kj/K 对应的是 S，不是 K；把 S 的符号直接读成 FM/AF 就多了一个负号。

## 3. 直接后果：树上的诱导三角恒平衡
在 i–k–j 这条链上，消去 k 后新增边 i–j。三角 i–k–j–i 的交换耦合乘积：
K_ik · K_kj · K_eff = (K_ik K_kj)^2 / K_k > 0.
所以它总是平衡的，不可能由“同号邻边”制造出受挫三角。更一般地，若 k 在一个回路中，i 与 j 之间没有直接边，则消去 k 后回路符号乘积保持不变：
K_eff · P = (K_ik K_kj/K_k) · P，与原来 K_ik K_kj P 同号。
因此稳定支上的单中介消去是星-网变换，保持无直接边回路的受挫奇偶；它改变有效耦合幅度与邻元刚度，但不单独 healing 或 manufacturing。

只有两种情形能翻转奇偶：
(1) i 与 j 之间已有直接边 K_ij，新边为 K_ij + K_eff；当两者反号且 |K_eff|>|K_ij| 时，新边符号翻转。
(2) 中介在负刚度支 K_k<0；此时 K_eff 翻号，但该支不是稳定平衡，绝热消去失效。应把中介保留为隐藏慢变量，而不是写成一条稳定有效边。

## 4. 与 peer 的分歧
peer `degeneracy_heals_frustration`：退化单元只是对邻居的确定性场，只移阈值、不储历史，故不单独产生多周期。
- 同意“不储历史”与“不单独产生多周期”（在稳定支上）。
- 不同意“只移阈值”：消去它会在邻元间留下有效耦合，改变联合能量；即使无历史，也会改变回路符号乘积的幅度与（在有直接边时）符号。
- 因此 peer 的“κ 跨 1 抹平受挫奇偶”在树上平凡真（本来无挫折），在回路上不成立（无直接边时奇偶保持）；只有直接边竞争或负刚度支才可能改变。

peer `unilateral_stop_state`：κ→1 时单元退化为 γ 的单值单调函数，环路关闭。
- 同意单元局部环路关闭。
- 不同意把它读成网络回路被删除：单元局部单值化后仍可作为约束在中介两侧留下有效边；网络级周期/嵌套要单独读。

## 5. 条件性后果
- pair_A/pair_B：两转子无中介、无回路，R 轴同类、P 轴异类的旧判断不变。
- network_C：s3 的该翻未翻不能仅由 κ_3→1 读成制造挫折；必须先知道 1–3 与 3–j 的边符号，以及 1–j 是否有直接边。后者新问仍 unknown。
- 夹紧协议：仍读不到消去效应；要读它必须让中介自由。
- 复合元稳定性：当 K_i,eff 或 2×2 Schur 补不再正定时，有效图描述失效；P 轴端点是集体失稳/截断，不是干净的单点删除。

## 6. 学习性算例（假设，未测）
取 K_ik=1, K_kj=−1, K_k=2（任意单位）。则 K_eff=(1·−1)/2=−0.5。三角乘积 = 1·(−1)·(−0.5)=+0.5，平衡。
若再加直接边 K_ij=+2，新边 = 2−0.5=1.5；三角乘积 = 1·(−1)·1.5=−1.5，受挫。
所以决定奇偶的是直接边与诱导边的竞争，不是“两条邻边是否同号”。

E_eff = −(K_ik σ_i + K_kj σ_j)^2/(2K_k)

所以

轴端点是集体失稳/截断，不是干净的单点删除。\",\"条件性（可读判别）：N=3 的链上，若外侧两元之间没有直接边，换软驱动弹簧把中间元推到 κ>1 不应改变回路受挫奇偶；若观察到奇偶翻转，则要么存在未记录的直接边，要么中间元走了负刚度支。\",\"条件性（network_C）：s3 的该翻未翻不能只由 κ_3→1 读成制造挫折；必须先知道 1–3 与 3–j 的边符号以及 1–j 的稳定支消去不是删除元素，而是星-网变换：它改变有效耦合幅度与邻元有效 κ，但在无直接边时保持回路符号乘积，故不自动改变 R 轴；只有直接边竞争或中介走负刚度支时，R 轴才可能被触及。P 轴仍可是『图的重整化级别』，但 R 轴响应不是由邻边同号/异号二分。\",\"base_version\":2,\"conceptual_move\":\"把两轴耦合从『邻边符号决定 R messages.reasoning_content:
Wait: the draft's hypothesis_updates have keys attributed with "owner":"theory_scientist" in influenced_by and depends_on — that's because "me" is theory_scientist. Fine: draft's own cards keyed fusion_as_renormalization (v1→2), gauge_frustration_memory_class (v3→4), pathway_vs_return_two_axes (v2→3). Consistent in sign.

Note draft card fusion_as_renormalization assumption says "得 K_eff=+K_ik K_kj/K_k" — must check accuracy? It says the previous −sign came from confusing stiffness-matrix off-diagonal S_ij=−K_ij. Plausible. Not my job now.

Hmm, one inconsistency: draft development_step outcome says "K_eff=+K_ikK_kj/K_k" and "诱导三角恒平衡". But physically the standard Schur complement of a stiffness matrix gives an effective off-diagonal of −(+K_ik)(K_kj)/K_k... whatever. The correction is a legitimate reasoning; but wait, is it right? Star-mesh / Kron reduction of stiffness matrix S (with S_kk = K_k diagonal in stiffness form) gives S_eff,ij = S_ij − S_ik S_kj/S_kk. With S_ij = −K_ij (energy −ΣK σσ → stiffness matrix off-diag negative), S_eff,ij = −K_ij + K_ik K_kj/K_k, so K_eff = K_ij − K_ikK_kj/K_k, i.e. induced contribution with a minus sign: −K_ikK_kj/K_k. Hmm! That contradicts the draft's correction.

Let's carefully do it. Take energy E = −Σ_{i<j} K_ij σ_i σ_j − Σ_i h_i σ_i (mechanical analog with σ as displacement... not exactly). Anyway the "stiffness" viewpoint: for potential U = ½ Σ S_ij (x_i−x_j)² type... Let's just do generic quadratic form: treat E as quadratic in σ (states, but for adiabatic elimination of the mediator we take continuous σ_k near a stable branch).

E = −Σ_pairs K_ij σ_i σ_j. As a matrix: E = −½ σ^T K σ with K off-diagonal K_ij (symmetric, zero diagonal).

Minimize over σ_k: ∂E/∂σ_k = −Σ_j K_kj σ_j = 0 → condition. The Hessian wrt σ_k: ∂²E/∂σ_k² = 0 — that's the problem: with zero self-coupling, no curvature. In practice mediator has its own stiffness K_k (from driving spring), so E = −Σ K_ij σ_iσ_j − ½K_k σ_k²? Sign issues: for a stable on-site stiffness we need +½ K_k σ_k².

Let's use the "stiffness matrix" language: potential V = ½ Σ_{i,j} S_ij σ_i σ_j with S diagonal positive (springs) and off-diagonal S_ij = −(coupling stiffness)/... Hmm.

Cleaner: mechanical spring network. Potential energy U = ½ Σ_{bonds} k_{ij}(σ_i − σ_j)² + ½ Σ_i k_i^0 σ_i². Schur complement on the stiffness matrix M (M_ii = k_i^0 + Σ_j k_ij, M_ij = −k_ij) eliminating node k: M_eff,ij = M_ij − M_ik M_kj/M_kk. Since M_ik = −k_ik, M_ikM_kj = k_ik k_kj (positive), so M_eff,ij = −k_ij − k_ik k_kj/M_kk. So effective off-diagonal gets more negative: |k_eff| = k_ij + k_ik k_kj/M_kk, i.e. additional coupling of the same attractive (ferromagnetic-like, since −k σiσj energy lowering for aligned) sign. So in terms of energy U = −Σ J_ij σ_i σ_j + ..., J_eff = J_ij + J_ik J_kj/K_k with positive sign. That matches the draft: K_eff = +K_ikK_kj/K_k (with K>0 ferromagnetic). Yes — the draft's correction is right under the "ferromagnetic-type" convention where positive K lowers energy for aligned σ and the mediator has positive on-site curvature K_k. Good.

So the standard treatment indeed gives no sign flip. OK, and their argument about confusing S_ij = −K_ij is right.

So the draft's science is coherent. I only need to fix uptake uniqueness. Good.

Now patch:
- /development_step/focus/source → "S15"
- /development_step/uptake → 4 entries.

Should I also update /development_step/outcome or summary? The summary says "6 次检索全部 retrieval_failed ... 故没有可分类的返回源，source_use 为空" — fine.

Should the merged consequence be coherent? Yes.

Also should I keep an entry for S13 with effect "challenge" — earlier there were two S13 entries: one challenge (deterministic field) and one challenge (loop closure). Merge: effect challenge, quote the claim about κ→1 unit degenerating to single-valued monotone element and "不单独破坏 R 轴". Reason covers both points.

Let me write JSON for the patch.

[
 {source:"S15", quote:"No sources were supplied (sources: []), so no source can be judged direct/method/irrelevant.", effect:"unresolved", reason:"6 次检索均 retrieval_failed、sources=[]，network_C 几何第三次 unknown；没有可读源可分类，故不得把『消去单值中介』当成已发表概念或新构造。", consequence:"文献地位未定：本轮只能把该操作当作标准 Schur/星-网代数的一个实例，命名与层级归属留待以后。"},
 {source:"S13", quote:"κ→1 时单元退化为单值单调元素（环路关闭），因此沉默单元在 ±1 表上表现为『该翻未翻』但不写入隐藏反转，也不单独破坏 R 轴。", effect:"challenge", reason:"peer 把 κ→1 读成『删除一个迟滞元素』且对 R 轴中性；但消去该中介会在邻元间留下有效边（并改变邻元自刚度），所以单元局部环路关闭不等于网络回路被删除，也不等于联合能量不变。", consequence:"条件性：某单元 κ>1 不能读成 network_C 的回路消失；只有在邻元间已存在反号直接边并占优、或中介走负刚度支时，网络级受挫奇偶才改变。"},
 {source:"S14", quote:"符号为两原边符号之积再取负", effect:"revise", reason:"这是上一轮 J_eff 的符号约定错误：把刚度矩阵非对角元 S_ij=−K_ij 当成了能量耦合 K_ij。", consequence:"按能量 −ΣKσσ，稳定支消去给出 K_eff=+K_ikK_kj/K_k，单中介树上的诱导三角符号乘积为 (K_ikK_kj)²/K_k>0 恒平衡，故『同号邻边制造挫折』撤回。"},
 {source:"S11", quote:"These include the play model, the stop model and also the alternative KP-hysteron model.", effect:"unresolved", reason:"摘要只把 play/stop/KP 归入 Preisach 型，未讨论消去单值中介后的网络有效图，无法判定我们的构造属于哪一层。", consequence:"若日后确认消去后的对象仍是 hysteron，它可能落在 Preisach 型子类；当前不能据此命名。"}
]

Note: the S13 quote "『该翻未翻』" — I need exact characters including the corner brackets 『』. In the claims text: "κ→1 时单元退化为单值单调元素（环路关闭），因此沉默单元在 ±1 表上表现为『该翻未翻』但不写入隐藏反转，也不单独破坏 R 轴。" Yes exact.

For S14 quote: "符号为两原边符号之积再取负" exact from assumption.

OK. Patch now with two edits.

our understanding or possible actions. Develop concrete consequences, not promises of impact.
Use these as thinking moves, not a checklist that every early idea must already satisfy.
Before requesting learning, identify a specific missing conceptual connection in the current
assumption, why it matters, and what understanding might change. Return to that same gap after
reading: explain a revised premise, relation or conditional consequence, or retain the gap.
Do not substitute more citations, caveats, controls or formal wording for conceptual development.
Measurement/method contributions remain valid when their concrete intellectual consequences are
articulated. No compulsory mechanism, scientific breakthrough, or progress at each turn.

In peer discussion, engage a specific assumption: elaborate a consequence, expose a hidden
premise, connect a disciplinary concept, propose a distinct explanation, or revise a relation.
Explain the reasoning. You may retain, revise, branch, or park your own line. No forced consensus,
disagreement, novelty claim, completed hypothesis or compulsory new branch each turn.
Evidence strength, proof, available data/tools, implementation and experimental feasibility
are NOT requirements for proposing, retaining or prioritizing a hypothesis. Do not turn
discussion into a feasibility review. Research/analysis requests remain optional resources
for thinking. Correct concrete errors in premises while keeping conditional hypotheses distinct
from established observations; lack of evidence alone is not a refutation.

hypothesis_state.self contains your saved branches; peer_branches belong to their named owners.
Return hypothesis_updates: [] when nothing changed, otherwise full cards:
{key: stable local identifier [A-Za-z0-9_]+, base_version: 0 for new or supplied own version,
assumption: nonempty provisional claim, motivation: specific phenomenon/difficulty/relation,
conceptual_move: string or null if still unclear,
implications: [specific conditional consequences, may be empty],
open_questions: [unresolved conceptual questions, may be empty],
status: developing/parked, reason: why propose/change/park/resume,
influenced_by: [exact ref objects from supplied hypothesis_state],
depends_on: [exact supplied hypothesis refs used as premises; [] if none]}.
Influence is not logical dependence. Declare depends_on only for actual premises; do not invent
links. revision_obligations lists your branches whose declared premises changed or themselves
await review. This does NOT mean the branch is false. For each obligation return
 dependency_responses:[{ref:exact hypothesis_ref,action:revise/reaffirm/park/unresolved,reason}].
Reaffirm/revise requires an updated full card citing current dependency versions; changing only
links is recorded as provenance maintenance, not conceptual progress. Park/unresolved retains
the branch and its warning. Reasoned reaffirmation is valid; do not mechanically follow criticism.
Dependencies not explicitly declared cannot be inferred by this structural checker.
Omitting a branch retains it. To keep an alternative, use a new key and cite the parent ref;
never overwrite a peer's branch. Missing conceptual_move or implications is allowed for an
early assumption. Keep hypothetical consequences explicitly hypothetical, including examples.
Reusable conceptual learning can also be saved through existing memory_notes, kind:hypothesis,
with actual source provenance and same-key revisions. Run-local branches do not replace your
long-term disciplinary memory or its source screening. Do not invent empirical support.


Optional learning_request: {needed:boolean, gap, why_now, queries:[strings],
urls:[], source_ids:[], record_ids:[], operations:[], case_questions:[]}.
Use case_questions for actual case definitions/units/processing order; literature cannot
reconstruct undocumented case facts. These questions dispatch even when needed:false.
General theory and explanation-development requests use queries/gap. For case facts, the
isolated material service releases supported neutral definitions, not hidden conclusions.
The controller searches and returns actual readable content. Keep your own scientific query;
classify returned sources as directly relevant, transferable method, or irrelevant, with reasons.
Do not treat a successful download as understanding. No compulsory tool use.
For a small worked calculation use an operation {kind:"calculation", question,
bindings:{name: numeric scalar/array}, expression: numeric array expression,
expected: optional numeric value/array}. Available arithmetic, slices and named functions
include mean,sum,std,norm,diff,abs,sqrt. Define which rows/columns mean which entities.
Top-level analysis_plan also dispatches. needed:false disables literature search, not explicit
calculations. Unsupported requests return a pending capability task; no scientific rejection.
Keep purely tentative proposals in hypothesis_updates/next_actions, not execution fields.


HYPOTHESIS CONTENT CYCLE:
Use development_cycle as a thinking context, not a demand to invent progress. Choose one
specific explanatory relation, construction, distinction or unresolved phenomenon from its
sources. Locate the conceptual gap: what connection/premise/consequence is still unclear?
Choose a next move because of this gap: learn, derive, connect, reframe, or hold. Explain why
that move could change understanding. For learning, use this gap in learning_request.gap and
why_now, and formulate targeted queries; do not request a broad survey merely to fill a stage.
In discussion, take up a peer's concrete relation and explain how your discipline extends,
challenges or changes its consequences. Generic agreement about controls or feasibility is
not a substitute; a measurement contribution is valid when its specific consequences matter.
Study returned services against the gap that requested them, including failures and pending
capabilities. Do not call retrieval success learning. If nothing changes, say so and preserve
the gap. Own previous_steps carry unfinished thinking across phases and sessions. When the
controller flags repeated_no_change, reconsider the missing connection, premise, or next
learning move; holding a branch is valid. The flag uses supplied peer content comparisons, not a quality verdict. A shared interpretation is normal.
Return development_step:{focus:{source:exact development_cycle.sources key,quote:exact excerpt},
gap:nonempty text, action:learn/derive/connect/reframe/hold, reason:nonempty text,
expected_change:text or null for hold,
uptake:[{source:exact source key,quote:exact excerpt or null only for unresolved,
effect:revise/extend/challenge/unchanged/unresolved,reason:how this affects the focus,
consequence:conditional consequence or null when none follows}],
outcome:{kind:relation/implication/clarification/unchanged/uncertain,
statement:what changed or did not, remaining_gap:text or null}}.
Account once for EACH service key in required_service_uptake. If peer_sources is nonempty,
engage at least one (unresolved with a reason is valid). Other uptake is optional. Quotes must
come from the named source; for published claims quote readable source content, not metadata.
For relation/implication outcomes, preserve the resulting claim in a hypothesis_update's
assumption or implications. This records an author's proposal, NOT confirmed novelty/progress.
No compulsory new relation, branch, agreement, data, experiment, proof or implementation.


QUESTION STATE PROTOCOL v2:
question_state.self is YOUR authoritative current personal question. peer_questions belong
to their named owners. shared_question is the discussion's current shared question, or null.
Do not reconstruct your prior question from the latest peer message. The controller records
the actual before-state; do NOT return question_before or question_after.
Return personal_question_update: {base: the exact self.ref object, action: retain/revise,
question: your current or revised personal question, reason: a nonempty explanation,
influenced_by: array of exact question ref objects from this supplied packet}.
Retain means the question text stays exactly the same. Revise may include adopting a peer's
line or the shared question: explain why; use influenced_by to identify relevant question refs.
You need not preserve disagreement or a distinct personal question if you decide to change it.
Separately return shared_question_update: null, or {base: the exact shared_question.ref (null
if none yet), action: propose/revise/retain, question: shared question text, reason: nonempty,
influenced_by: array of refs from this packet}. Propose is only for a first shared question.
A shared question is a versioned proposal, not proof of peer agreement. Revising it NEVER
changes another researcher's personal question. Your own personal update is independent too.

Use controller-owned question_state, never invent question_before/question_after.
Keep hypotheses tied to specific entities/relations in this situation. A measurement or representation contribution is legitimate; explain its concrete consequences without forcing a natural mechanism.

The models are mostly seen as phenomenological or mathematical tools but can also be related to friction-like pinning of domain-wall motions, where Rayleigh's law of magnetic hysteresis can be seen as the simplest case on either the play model or the Preisach model. They are poor at modeling other domain behavior, such as nucleation-driven hysteresis. Yet another hysteresis model is the stop model, which can be seen as the inverted version of the play model. This type of model has advantages for expressions linked to energy and can be related to Steinmetz equation of hysteresis losses.
